Package index

Building models

sim_model()
Create a block-diagram model
sim_add_block()
Add a block to a model
sim_connect()
Connect two blocks
sim_disconnect() sim_remove_block()
Remove a connection or a block
sim_set_block_params()
Change block parameters in a model
sim_blocks() sim_connections()
Inspect the blocks and connections of a model
sim_copy()
Copy a model
sim_param()
Refer to a model or subsystem parameter
sim_block_types()
List registered block types

Subsystems, events and state machines

sim_subsystem()
Hierarchical subsystems
sim_add_event() sim_zero_crossing() sim_at()
Model events: zero crossings, scheduled times and state resets
sim_transition()
State machine transitions
sim_check_state_machine()
Check a state machine definition

Compiling and running

sim_compile()
Compile a model into an execution plan
sim_set_params() sim_param_values()
Change parameters of a compiled plan
sim_run()
Simulate a compiled plan
sim_diagnostics()
Compilation diagnostics

Results

sim_signal() sim_states() sim_discrete_states() sim_events() sim_times()
Extract simulation output
plot(<sim_result>)
Plot simulation results

Experiments

sim_sweep() sim_monte_carlo()
Parameter sweeps and Monte Carlo experiments

Files, diagrams and extension

sim_write_json() sim_read_json() sim_model_to_list() sim_model_from_list()
Save and load models as JSON
sim_to_dot() plot(<sim_model>)
Draw or export a block diagram
sim_register_block_type()
Register a block type
